reason: The spacecraft is ready, and commanding ascent is the only available action.
expectation: I expect the switch to initiate ascent along the cleared path, though I don't know what happens next.

effect: Ascent succeeded, leaving the repaired ground support behind and completing the chapter.
reaction: Seeing the cave and panels shrink together was a satisfying visual farewell.

mostWorthwhile.text: Commanding ascent paid off the departure with a clear view of the place being left behind.

leastWorthwhile.text: The decision itself was necessarily simple: there was only one available action.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprising happened; the ascent was what I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: the switch had an explicit purpose.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue and see what the laboratories learn about the specimens, although this chapter offered little gameplay choice.
